moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio ch-blink, written here): Eyelid close 80 ms ease-in (2 frames), open 170 ms ease-out (3-4 frames), gaps 2-6 s, irregular. Demo: eye height x (1 - sin(pi u)) over 200 ms (symmetric), blinks at 0.8, 2.1, 2.35 (double) and 3.4 s in a 4 s loop. Params: close (80 ms) · open (170 ms) · gap (2–6 s) · seed. The recipe closes in 0.08 s (ease-in) and opens in 0.17 s (ease-out), 2–6 s apart.
